long_biography.plain_text:
Economou studied quantitative economics at Tufts and ocean systems management at MIT before working in New York for Lazard and tanker-pool operator Heidmar. He joined Cardiff Marine, his father George Economou's established shipping business, as executive vice-president in 2008. The move gave him experience inside a large family platform before he built a specialised gas-shipping business.

He founded TMS Cardiff Gas in 2011 to manage LNG and LPG carriers, later adding LNGShips for charter-focused gas transportation. Under his leadership, the company expanded through newbuilding programmes and long-term charters with major energy groups. Christos's role centred on founding and directing gas-shipping ventures, while George remained the broader TMS group's owner and associated companies held the fleet.
